newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway January CPI rises 0.8 pct mnth/mnth.
newsitem.headline: Norway January CPI rises 0.8 pct mnth/mnth.

text.p: Statistics Norway issued the following economic indicator.
NORWAY CONSUMER PRICES JAN 1997 DEC 1996 JAN 1996
NOTE -- Ten economists polled by Reuters forecast a year-on-year rise in January of 2.5 percent and for inflation to increase by an average 0.3 percent month-on-month.
Statistics Norway attributed the jump in inflation mainly to higher taxes on petrol, beverages and tobacco as well as a continued rise in electricity prices.
"Electricy prices grew by more than six percent from December to January," a statement said. "The reason for the increase in prices was higher transmission and power fees."
It said petrol prices went up by almost seven percent in January and that prices for beverages and tobacco increased by an average six percent.
But Norwegian households saw a four-percent reduction in January on telephone and cellular phone tariffs to help soften the impact of the price rises.
